feature_description: 63 floats: wrist-centred, palm-length-scaled xyz for 21 MediaPipe hand landmarks. Order: [x0,y0,z0, x1,y1,z1, ..., x20,y20,z20]. Landmark 0 = wrist (always 0,0,0 after centering).
IMPORTANT_LIMITATIONS: All samples come from ONE signer -- not a cross-user evaluation.
10 samples per class is far below what is needed for reliable stats.
CV accuracy measures memorisation of one signer's style.
This model is NOT integrated into the SignVaani application.
Do not use these metrics to claim reliable ISL recognition accuracy.
